mapping.source_heading: ## Direct historical test: replacing a starter

gaps: Null evidence_cutoff means no exact timestamp was supplied; source date-level clocks remain in prose and are not silently sharpened.
Source-level publication/retrieval and metric gaps remain as originally disclosed.
Exact owner and final evidence deadline remain unknown where not supplied.
capture_clock_semantics: For issue/comment bundles, retrieved_at is the observed start of the sequential issue + all-comments retrieval, not an exact response-completion timestamp. Later raw-comment metadata reads only supply missing creation/update clocks; body equality is verified. Linked file retrieved_at is the observed time after its fetch completed.
